statement: An accidental earlier character exists in the world Diamond Bluff (starting at a stadium entrance, wielding a wood axe); it is not the real survivor
The survivor is Morgan Reed, Evacuee scenario, in the new world Stirling City, starting Spring day 61 at 8:00 AM in evac shelter A-23
The ground-floor cupboard in evac shelter A-23 holds 23 small cardboard boxes of protein ration
A flight of stairs in the north part of the shelter ground floor leads down to the shelter basement
NPC Racheal Burris in the shelter is asthmatic and asks the player to fetch her an inhaler (the record calls it antibiotics); the player accepted
The shelter basement has a restroom with toilets and sinks, and a sink there holds 20 soap bars, 1 scrub brush and 2 paper
A basement room holds a paper wrapper, a FEMA evacuation pamphlet, a glass shard, a plastic bottle and a plastic knife (the empty plastic bottle was taken)
Starting inventory is a messenger bag, pocket knife, matchbook (20 matches), smartphone with flashlight app and two units of clean water; no weapon, fists wielded
The player carries 5 boxed protein rations in the messenger bag, taken from the cupboard
The smartphone flashlight app drains the phone battery and was switched off after use in the basement
The quarterstaff recipe needs one long stick plus a cutting-2 tool, takes 1 hour, and fabrication 1 with missing Carving proficiency gives about 55% minor failure
Spear recipes need a spear shaft plus tools and parts the player lacks, and no cudgel or club recipes are listed
West of the shelter door is an open field with a paved road in front; the shelter lies east of the field
Two fat zombies were spotted about 60 tiles northwest in the field and safe mode is on and blocks walking
Plan: find a long stick to craft a quarterstaff, find a sustainable safe-water and cooking container, avoid the two zombies and reassess direction

note: took the stairs down and is now in the basement
saw the paper wrapper and pamphlet pile again when passing the bench
flashlight deactivated before leaving the shelter
checked quarterstaff recipe to choose a melee weapon
decision to continue west or reroute because of the spotted zombies
